tools.name: transit_operators
tools.description: List all transit operators available in the 511 API (BART, Muni, Caltrain, AC Transit, etc.).

tools.name: muni_routes
tools.description:
List all SF Muni routes (bus, rail, cable car).

Args:
  - operator_id: Optional operator ID (default 'SF' for Muni)

tools.name: muni_stop_search
tools.description: Search Muni stops by stop name, stop code, or route. Use this before muni_departures if you do not know the stop code.

tools.name: muni_nearby_stops
tools.description: Find Muni stops near a latitude/longitude point.

tools.name: muni_departures
tools.description:
Get real-time departure predictions for a Muni stop.

Args:
  - stop_code: The 5-digit stop code
  - operator_id: Optional (default 'SF')

tools.name: muni_departures_by_route_stop
tools.description: Get real-time departures at a stop filtered to one Muni route/line.

tools.name: muni_line
tools.description:
Get details for a specific Muni line including stops.

Args:
  - line_id: Route/line ID (e.g. 'N', '14', '38R')
  - operator_id: Optional (default 'SF')

tools.name: muni_alerts
tools.description:
Get current Muni service alerts, detours, and disruptions.

Args:
  - operator_id: Optional (default 'SF')

tools.name: muni_status_summary
tools.description: Summarize current Muni service status from 511 service alerts.

tools.name: muni_vehicles
tools.description:
Get real-time GPS positions of Muni vehicles.

Args:
  - operator_id: Optional (default 'SF')

tools.name: muni_schedule
tools.description:
Get the timetable/schedule for a specific Muni line.

Args:
  - line_id: Route/line ID (e.g. 'N', '14', '38R')
  - operator_id: Optional (default 'SF')
